title: OTHER CANDIDATE 'FOREFATHERS' OF IDEONOMY:

lists.name: OTHER CANDIDATE 'FOREFATHERS' OF IDEONOMY:
items: ?Jean Piaget (SWISS): botanist, child psychologist, cognitive scientist (1896?-198?)
Peter Mark Roget (English) 1779-1869: physician, philologist, author of Thesaurus of English Words and Phrases (1852)

Henricus Glareanus (Swiss, b in Mollis—now in W. Germany, 1488-1563): Humanist, poet, music theorist (book Dodecachordon), monk-?; works: commentaries on Greek and Roman writers, mathematical and descriptive geography, some musical treatises (REFERENCE: Britannica, Micropaedia).
Carl Gustav Jung (Swiss): psychologist, psychiatrist (1875 Jl 26-1961 Je 6).
